title: Re-record the spawn proof from a live herdr 0.8.0 round trip
action: Re-record skills/bee-herding/references/spawn-proof.md from a real run against the installed herdr, per D12 and the plan's phase 1, then run the regen chain inside this cell (bee dev regen: render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order). The existing document proves the OLD single-command form and explicitly forbids splitting first, so it must be replaced, not amended. Run the full round trip, not just a spawn: create a throwaway worktree, split a runtime pane, start an agent into it with --kind and --pane, send it a prompt with herdr agent prompt --wait, read the reply back with herdr agent read --source recent-unwrapped, then tear the whole thing down. The round trip matters beyond this cell: it is the only evidence before the core crate exists about how herdr's real idle/done/blocked statuses behave, so record the observed status at each step verbatim, including whether a status was observed without focusing the pane. Capture two specific pieces of evidence that the old proof captured and that nobody has observed under the new --kind plus agent-argument split: the argv echoed back in the start response, and the pane status bar reading that the working agent is running with permissions bypassed. Without both, the claim that the permission-posture split (R4) survived the repair is unevidenced. Record the exact workspace, tab and pane ids used. Note in the document that the worktree-creation step must run from the MAIN checkout because bee worktree new refuses from inside a linked worktree. Never split or otherwise disturb the pane hosting the session that runs this cell — resolve your own pane id first (herdr pane current --current) and exclude it explicitly. Tear down everything created: close the pane, remove the worktree, delete the branch, unregister the grant. FINALLY, and only after the proof is re-recorded, make three small corrections in skills/bee-herding/references/role-dispatch.md and nothing else in that file. (1) Cell ho-1 left a deliberate present-tense caveat in step 2 reading that spawn-proof.md 'still describes the pre-0.8.0 form as of this writing'. That sentence becomes false the moment this cell lands; reword it so it points at the re-recorded proof as the live evidence for the split-then-start order. (2) An independent judge found a dangling sentence in step 2: 'Keep --ratio 0.5 unless the geometry rule computes otherwise'. The geometry rule described just above it computes a DIRECTION (right versus down), never a ratio, so no rule can compute otherwise. Reword it to say plainly that 0.5 is the ratio to pass, and drop the phantom condition — or, if the live run showed a different ratio is needed for a readable layout, record what you observed and say that instead. (3) The command forms write --timeout <ms> without ever naming a value, while D12 in CONTEXT.md specifies 60000. Name the value the live run actually used, in both the step 3 command and the quick-reference row.

truths: The proof records a real run against herdr 0.8.0, with the commands and their responses as observed.
The recorded run covers start, prompt and read — not a spawn alone.
The argv echo and the bypassed-permissions indicator both appear in the recorded evidence.
The document no longer tells a reader that agent start opens its own pane or that splitting first leaks a pane.
No herdr agent start invocation anywhere in the bee-herding skill still carries --cwd, --workspace, --tab, --split or --no-focus.
role-dispatch.md no longer says spawn-proof.md describes the pre-0.8.0 form; it points at the re-recorded proof instead.
role-dispatch.md's --ratio sentence states the ratio to pass without referring to a geometry rule that cannot compute one.
The agent start timeout carries a concrete value, the one the live run used, in both the step 3 command and the quick-reference row.
Nothing created by the run is left behind: no pane, no worktree, no branch, no grant.
artifacts: skills/bee-herding/references/spawn-proof.md — the live split-then-start round trip with observed statuses, ids, argv echo, permission indicator, and the teardown
key_links: The command form recorded here matches the form role-dispatch.md section 8 instructs, exactly — including the timeout value.
prohibitions: Do not split, resize, rename or close the pane hosting the session that runs this cell.
Do not leave any worktree, branch, grant or pane behind after the recording.
Do not run herdr server stop.
Do not change section 8's command order, the geometry direction rule, the pane-close rule or the settle rule — cell ho-1 owns those; only the three corrections named in the action are yours.
Do not edit any file under .claude/, .claude-plugin/, .codex-plugin/, .agents/ or .opencode/ by hand.
